browserDrives.target: the default build of the validated tree, each drive on its own local preview server, with Playwright 1.61.1 and Chromium 149.0.7827.55
browserDrives.passes: Two passes on the same build and tree; each drive is listed with the pass it passed in. In the first, six drives could not start their preview server because a preview server orphaned by the earlier run still held astro's lock, and the compatibility drive (tests/relationship-wheel-drive.mjs), which waits a fixed 2.5 s for its own server, navigated before the server was up (net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED) and left it running. With both servers stopped, all seven passed in the second pass. The compare drive rewrites docs/platform/evidence/chart-compare/browser-drive.json, the committed rc.8 acceptance record; it was restored from git.
browserDrives.earlierRun: The same drives ran once before on this branch, on an earlier build. Three stopped. The compare drive's rewritten fixture records lacked rc.15's result.timeScale and were refused, and the chart-ownership drive counted rc.15's one-argument chart builder as a second natal builder; c975048b corrected both drives, and no site code changed for them. The compatibility drive navigated before its preview server was up, passed when run again, and left the server that held the lock in the first pass above.

loadSensitiveTests: None failed in the final run. In an earlier full run on this branch (09:11 UTC), with the machine loaded, one or more tests in each of six files exceeded vitest's 5 s default: src/lib/engine/void-of-course.test.ts and scripts/angles-grid.test.mjs, which now have 30 s (913790fa; on rc.15 each engine call takes about a fifth longer than on rc.14), and scripts/precision-alpha-types.test.mjs, src/lib/profile/saved-record-inactive.test.ts, scripts/platform-candidate-docs.test.mjs and scripts/report-bundles.test.mjs, unchanged. rc.14's record names the precision-alpha and saved-record tests for the same reason; those two passed alone, and all six pass in the final run.
limits: The site-output comparison is the site against itself on two archives, not a measurement against a reference.
The time basis's own accuracy is the engine's measurement; this record checks that the site uses it.
@zodiacs/engine/timing and @zodiacs/engine/vedic, which the site does not use, are not measured here.
No push, merge, deployment, npm release or model-spending approval is implied by these checks.

publication.note: The MCP artifactCommit names 218de839, which carries the archive, pinned in 434403fa.
